ed33c3eb3873.text: Wildcard Pipeline fits into ComfyUI. Here is a Context node with three lists, as it looks out of the box.

ed981a9ba2f1.text: Plate armor carries a negative, and it lands in the negative prompt by itself.

eef3d826cb31.text: Here it is. The list on the left has how-tos, guides, each node and each module.

ef02a1e32300.text: Type a template. Each dollar-sign name is replaced by what its list rolled.

f0f12a8d4482.text: Accepts groups also let constraints match tag for tag, and tags filter references inside wildcards. Both come next.

f2567cdd4908.text: A Context Loop runs the workflow several times from one click. Each frame rolls its own picks.

f2d342f41fc5.text: Now make Colors pick two for this node: right-click it, Edit, and set the pick to exactly two.

f50d114bc4b9.text: You can also write several picks right in a template or an option. Curly brackets, a count, two dollar signs, the joiner, two more dollar signs, then the choices.

f56a1e6148f6.text: Roll until a knight or a mage turns up away from the forest.

f5b117624e40.text: Change the seed, and every list rolls again.

f642ea732239.text: Debug shows what each reference rolled.

f9a5d8143a7c.text: Any other time gets soft natural light.

f9ed444fa84e.text: This one sets style to a painting look, and it carries a negative too.

fbd797ce07e7.text: A template is the sentence the Assembler fills in. Once you like one, keep it in your library.

fc506693480a.text: Debug lists every variable and the option it rolled.

fe0d8098b56e.text: Roll a few seeds: two or three colors each time.

fe48b0868bdd.text: The hair list already reads the colors, so hide Colors with its globe button. Then fold the frame.

ff5604c85535.text: Below are the details. Write tags with spaces turns blue underscore hair into blue hair, which reads better in a prompt.
